operation.summary: Create a connection with native URL/header validation; request UUID/digest durably prevents duplicate creation after process restart; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: url
body.description: Write-only preset URL, up to 2048 characters; required on create

body.name: preset
body.description: Discovered preset; otherwise recognised from URL

body.name: allow_private
body.description: Native private-network HTTP/port policy, default false

body.name: headers
body.description: Write-only native headers; null clears; omitted preserves on update

body.name: extra
body.description: Write-only preset fields; null clears; omitted preserves on update

body.name: enabled
body.description: Disable cancels pending deliveries; true re-enables subject to limits

body.name: signing_secret
body.description: Write-only Standard Webhooks whsec_ + base64 of 32 receiver-generated random bytes; replacement rotates with 24-hour overlap

body.name: alert_secret
body.description: Write-only alerts/event-delivery HMAC key: 64 lowercase hex characters encoding 32 receiver-generated random bytes; replacement has no overlap

operation.returns: safe connection metadata; supplied/generated keys are never returned; provision receiver-owned keys for signature validation
